newsitem.title: ANDORRA: SOCCER-ANDORRA RUN OUT OF STEAM IN FINAL STRETCH OF DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDORRA RUN OUT OF STEAM IN FINAL STRETCH OF DEBUT.

text.p: Andorra ran out of steam in the final stretch of their international debut game on Wednesday and after letting in four goals in the last quarter hour went down 6-1 to Estonia.

Andorra, a tiny country sandwiched in the Pyrenean mountains between France and Spain, had goalkeeper Alfonso to thank for keeping in touch with Estonia in the early stages and were able to pull back to 1-1 thanks to a goal by Pol after 61 minutes.

But Estonia's Arbeiter gave his side the lead again three minutes later and, as Andorra tired, the visitors were able to take advantage of their superior fitness to score four more. Arbeiter finished with four goals
